description: Extract text per page from a PDF given by public URL or base64 (max 4 MiB, 100 pages). No OCR: scanned PDFs are flagged as likely_scanned. Price: 0.02 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/pdf-text.

joined.description: Also return all pages joined in 'text'.

pages.description: 1-based pages to read. Default: all (up to max_pages).

pdf_base64.description: Alternative to 'url': base64 PDF bytes (max 4 MiB decoded).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the PDF (max 4 MiB, 3 redirects, public IPs only).

name: pdf_text
title: PDF text extraction
